+ def create_fallback_view(fig, onion, radius):
+     """
+     Create a fallback elliptical view when other methods fail.
+     
+     Args:
+         fig: The Figure object to add traces to
+         onion: The onion model
+         radius: The radius of the onion
+         
+     Returns:
+         Tuple of (y_min, y_max, z_min, z_max) for the plot ranges
+     """
+     # Determine vertical stretch factor
+     if isinstance(onion, RealisticOnion):
+         vertical_stretch = onion.vertical_stretch
+     else:
+         vertical_stretch = 1.0
+     
+     # Create a full ellipse
+     theta = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 200)
+     y_coords = radius * np.cos(theta)
+     z_coords = radius * vertical_stretch * np.sin(theta)
+     
+     # Add the main profile
+     fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
+         x=y_coords, 
+         y=z_coords,
+         mode='lines',
+         line=dict(color='darkgreen', width=2),
+         name='Profile'
+     ))
+     
+     # Add layers
+     for i, layer_r in enumerate(onion.layer_radii[1:], 1):
+         scaling_factor = layer_r / onion.radius
+         y_layer = radius * scaling_factor * np.cos(theta)
+         z_layer = radius * scaling_factor * vertical_stretch * np.sin(theta)
+         
+         fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
+             x=y_layer, 
+             y=z_layer,
+             mode='lines',
+             line=dict(color='gray', width=1, dash='dot'),
+             name=f'Layer {i}'
+         ))
+     
+     return -radius, radius, -radius * vertical_stretch, radius * vertical_stretch
+
